_about: Marlowe's (1564-1593) Doctor Faustus, Dyce's text. Added from the classical reading lists (Classical Conversations, Canon Press, New Saint Andrews, Logos School/Online, Bethlehem College & Seminary, Memoria Press, CiRCE): docs/reading-lists/READING-LISTS.tsv. Bloom addition 2026-11-03 (Bloom's Western Canon): marlowe-works.

marlowe-doctor-faustus: The Tragical History of Doctor Faustus (c. 1592; ed. Dyce)

marlowe-works: The Works of Christopher Marlowe, ed. C. F. Tucker Brooke

marlowe-works.year: 1910 first edition; this scan is the 'Impression of 1925' (title verso: 'First edition, 1910 / Impression of 1925')
marlowe-works.evidence: Read title page and verso; an unrevised reprint, fine.
marlowe-works.case: One-volume complete Marlowe (plays, poems, translations); we hold only Doctor Faustus (and Edward II on mason-poetry).
marlowe-works.note: PG has Bullen's Works vols 2-3 (42724, 21262) and single plays if a PG text is preferred.
